item.title: Geraldton Police charge two men with stealing decorations from homes in Bluff Point on Christmas Day
item.description: Two young men have been charged with stealing Christmas decorations from several homes in the Bluff Point area on Christmas Day.

item.title: A Geraldton family’s guide to New York: Derek Goforth journals his long-awaited trip to the US
item.description: New York City greets you like a handshake you were not ready for — firm, loud and completely certain of itself. Derek Goforth chronicles the first stop of his family’s long-awaited for American adventure.

item.title: Death of 37yo man riding e-scooter in Geraldton comes as council prepares to vote on Beam licence renewal
item.description: The future of rented e-scooters in Geraldton is in limbo as the council prepares to review the private operator’s contract in the wake of the Christmas Eve death of a 37-year-old man.

item.title: What I See with Peter Fiorenza: The Bondi terrorism attack is a frightening example of a shrinking world
item.description: For me, Bondi is a clear indication that the world and all its troubles are shrinking. Today, troubling issues that seemed to be something that happened in a far away land are now right on our doorstep.

item.title: Walkaway Cup socials: More than 1800 people flock to Geraldton Turf Club for final racing event of the year
item.description: Geraldton locals soaked up the sunshine and festive atmosphere as they farewelled the 2025 leg of the racing season in style at the 2025 Walkaway Cup.

item.title: Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League: Sporties duo leads men’s and women’s Cricketer of the Year count
item.description: With the 2025-26 Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League season in recess, Geraldton’s cricket expert Victor Tanti takes a look at the key statistics and top performances.

item.title: Geraldton welcomes the New Year with a peaceful night and laid-back day
item.description: Geraldton residents managed to ring in the New Year with maximum fun and minimum destruction, with no major incidents occurring in the region.

item.title: House fire in Rangeway leaves two families without a home in the New Year
item.description: A fire at a residential property in Rangeway has left two single mums and their children without accommodation in the new year.

item.title: Geraldton’s rising swimming stars prepare to take on regional rivals in Swimming WA Country Championships
item.description: Some of Geraldton’s youngest and most exciting swimming prospects will battle it out in the Swimming WA Country Championships held at the Perth HPC Centre, starting this Friday.

item.title: Year in Review: The local stories that grabbed our attention for good and bad reasons in final months of 2025
item.description: The local headlines that dominated the news in Geraldton in the final three months of 2025 certainly put an exclamation mark on the end of the year, for all manner of reasons.
